name: Wasabi Mizuta
bio: Wasabi Mizuta is a freelance voice actress and was formerly represented by Production Baobab and Ken Production. As of April 2005, she is the voice of the title character in the long running Doraemon anime.
place: Aoyama, Mie, Japan [now Iga, Mie, Japan]
